# Straight lines — summary

| Need | Formula / method |
|---|---|
| Gradient 📘 | $m = \dfrac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1}$ |
| Equation 📘 | $y = mx + c$ · $ax + by + d = 0$ · $y - y_1 = m(x - x_1)$ |
| Midpoint 📘 | $\left(\dfrac{x_1 + x_2}{2},\ \dfrac{y_1 + y_2}{2}\right)$ |
| Distance 📘 | $\sqrt{(x_1 - x_2)^2 + (y_1 - y_2)^2}$ |
| Parallel 🧠 | $m_1 = m_2$ |
| Perpendicular 🧠 | $m_1 \times m_2 = -1$ |
| Right angle? 🧠 | Converse of Pythagoras, or gradients multiply to $-1$ |

**Perpendicular bisector of [AB]:** midpoint → negative reciprocal gradient → line through the midpoint.

**Where two lines meet:** solve simultaneously (substitution / elimination; GDC on Paper 2).

**Watch out:** rearrange $ax + by + d = 0$ before reading the gradient · write "$y = \ldots$", not "$L = \ldots$" · integer coefficients when asked for $ax + by + d = 0$.
